intervention.name: strict band-0 admission at spatial lowpass call sites
intervention.waits_for: band 0 of the input wavelet to become valid

pre_registration.prediction: zero corrupt outputs in B; corruption returns in A-prime

notes: All 120 intervention calls produced one single output digest.
The gate demonstrably waited in 22 of 120 calls, always on ch1 index 1, the channel that corrupts.
No call showed a spin where no incomplete lowpass existed, so the wait is not a blanket sleep.
A and A-prime share one binary; only the environment variable differs.

what_this_does_not_establish: No Windows, macOS or EPYC parity was measured in this pass.
No rate or throughput claim: the gate is test-only and was not benchmarked.
The underlying upstream defect is unchanged; this is a controlled intervention, not a production patch.
Only one packet, one resolution (HALF) and one output format (BGRA) were exercised.
The 22 observed waits are single-yield windows; longer stalls on other hardware are not characterised.
